reason: I'm not paying $29.99 for a month of magnesium when Toplux is $23 and Goli is $19 and last longer. I don't buy supplements unless a doctor tells me to.
objection: It costs more than the brands I already know, and I think most supplements are a waste unless a doctor recommends it. The lab report is nice, but it doesn't tell me I need this.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor telling me I'm low on magnesium, and the price coming down to around $20 a month.
